representative_selection: same integrated with-walker case used in existing progress report; illustrative, not cohort estimate

batch.aggregation: completed cases only for time; within seed/mode average repetitions first, then equal seed weights
batch.version_scope: development integration records include revisions; counts are descriptive, not frozen-controller success rates
batch.low_speed_definition: from 50 ms position differences: speed < 0.01 m/s and abs yaw rate < 0.02 rad/s
batch.arm_moving_definition: norm of six joint velocity vector > 0.05 rad/s
batch.completion: return-door-closed event, two binned events, final base within 0.6 m of start; completed cases also checked for both end-in-bin flags
